segments.english:
11925—Umm Thabit bint Qays

ibn Shammas al-Ansariyya, (9) the sister of Thabit. Ibn Habib mentioned her

(1) Usd al-Ghaba, entry 7380.

(2) In A: “Umm Thabit bint Jabir ibn Atik.”

(3) Omitted from A.

(4) In A: “Jabir.”

(5) Usd al-Ghaba, entry 7381.

(6) Usd al-Ghaba, entry 7382.

(7) Omitted from A.

(8) In A: “She will appear under Umm Sahl bint Sahl.”

(9) Usd al-Ghaba, entry 7383.

segments.arabic: في المبايعات. وقال ابن سعد: تزوجها ثابت بن سفيان بن عدي بن عمرو، فولدت له سماكا، ولها ذكر في ترجمة ليلى بنت سماك.
segments.english: [Ibn Habib mentioned her] among the women who gave the pledge of allegiance. Ibn Sa'd said: Thabit ibn Sufyan ibn 'Adi ibn 'Amr married her, and she bore him Simak. She is also mentioned in the biographical notice of Layla bint Simak.
